{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print("Total rows:", len(df))
print("Unique patient_id:", df['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Duplicate patient_id count:", len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique())

# Check sample_seq per patient_id
duplicates = df[df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)]
duplicates_sorted = duplicates.sort_values(['patient_id', 'sample_seq'])

print("\nHighest sample_seq per patient_id:")
duplicates_sorted.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().head(10)

# Confirm that the highest sample_seq row is the one to keep
print("\nCount of patients with multiple sample_seq:", duplicates['patient_id'].nunique())"}
